detail.body:
- [ ] I, the PR author, have personally reviewed every line of this PR.

# What does this PR do?

Migrate DDP/FSDP wrapper settings and consumers to `cfg.ddp` as part of training-loop configuration consolidation (C09).

- Use the resolved wrapper config for construction, bucket/layout settings, communication hooks and checkpoint backend selection.
- Retain the Torch FSDP2-specific schema and all existing CLI flags. Keep `use_megatron_fsdp` only in `cfg.ddp`.
- Centralize wrapper validation and cross-config derivation. Optimizer-owned overlap settings remain authoritative in `cfg.optimizer`; runtime copies keep bucket/timer mutations out of serialized configuration.
- Preserve existing optimizer extension hooks and add behavioral coverage in existing test modules.

This remains a draft. It does not change GPU kernels or introduce a new checkpoint format. It overlaps #7778's removal of the duplicate distributed-init FSDP selector; retain that single-owner change when integrating either PR first.

## Issue tracking

Related to #3554.

## Contribution process

### Pre-checks

- [x] I have added relevant unit tests
- [ ] I have added relevant functional tests
- [ ] If this PR adds or changes a GPU kernel, I have added or updated its bit-exact determinism test (not applicable: configuration ownership only)
- [x] I have added proper typing to my code
- [x] I have added relevant documentation
- [ ] I have run the autoformatter on my PR

Validation on `abb5a178420c24eb01ea1a0bb5033dd727915d7d`: targeted eight-GPU tests passed, **519 passed / 6 skipped** on every rank. Coverage includes initialization/configuration, DDP helpers, MIMO, LSQ overrides, checkpoint loading and distributed/layer-wise optimizer save/load. Skips require a newer Transformer Engine or a different exact GPU topology.

All-files pre-commit was run in an isolated checkout: isort passed; Black/Pylint reported pre-existing unrelated findings. No unrelated formatting or copyright-year changes were included. The repository autoformatter requires a newer Git than the local environment provides.

### Code review

Independent complete-diff review completed before publication. Keep draft while upstream CI and remaining integration review proceed.

+    class OptimizerReached(Exception):

+

+        assert config.use_distributed_optimizer is run_config.ddp.use_distributed_optimizer is True
+        assert config.overlap_param_gather is run_config.ddp.overlap_param_gather is True
+        assert args.use_distributed_optimizer is args.overlap_param_gather is False
+        raise OptimizerReached
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(training, "get_megatron_optimizer", build_optimizer)
